description: This file defines an interface (ILocalStore) for local storage operations, including methods for opening a store, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and removing entries. It also includes a type alias for shared pointer to ILocalStore.

classes.name: ILocalStore
classes.description: Interface class providing methods for local storage management.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the local store with the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table with the given name.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit for the specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries starting from 'start' up to 'maxCount'.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from the specified table.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries within a range from 'start' to 'end'.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the specified table.
